test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Corruption is

P. misuse and abuse of public office, either directly

Q. typified by dishonesty, exploitation or the

R. or indirectly, for personal gains or unjust enrichment

S. in negation of due process or established protocol
solution:
The correct answer is indeed **1) QPRS**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Here is the correct order of the parts of the sentence:
 
• **Q.** **typified by dishonesty, exploitation or the: **This part introduces the concept of corruption and highlights its key characteristics, which include dishonesty and exploitation.
 
• P. misuse and abuse of public office, either directly</str
